text:
kevin.s: Quick check-in on AurumBank POC. They need IdP-initiated SAML for three apps, SCIM for user + group sync (deltas), custom RBAC mapped from Okta groups, and per-tenant domain verification. Also EU-only data residency and a rough Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta for presales. Who can own the runbook + pricing?

tara.p: I can pull a pricing sketch. do we know peak SCIM ops/day? that drives quota ask.

leah.s: Sales intel: ~12k users, ~3k DAU, daily full upsert at 02:00 UTC, frequent deltas during office hours, heavy group churn (many contractors). They want delegated tenant admins to manage roles.

ryan.eng: Notes: we support emitting SAML attributes for groups/roles. For nested groups, we don't expand on ingest; recommend IdP-level flattening or an intermediary sync lambda. Will add sample mapping in runbook.

kevin.s: Can we support Okta group-to-role claim mapping in the SAML assertion? need examples for customer's SSO team.

ryan.eng: Yes. SAML attribute example: <Attribute Name=\"roles\"> <AttributeValue>finance_admin</AttributeValue> ... We can include multiple values. Will add metadata snippet. Caveat: max assertion size needs attention for very large group counts.

leah.s: On SCIM: they prefer delta-first (near realtime), but will do nightly fulls. Recommend quota bump for Hosted if we expect many patch ops during day. Dedicated gives predictable throughput and faster retry windows.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Quote draft for dedicated POC uploaded: https://redwood.s3/quotes/aurumbank-dedicated-v2.pdf

tara.p: Preliminary ballparks (pre-sales table): Hosted (standard) = ~€900/mo; Hosted + SCIM quota increase = ~€2.5k/mo; Dedicated onboarding (one-time) = ~€22k; Dedicated recurring = ~€7k/mo. EU-only deployment may add a region premium. these are provisional.

kevin.s: They also asked about domain proofing across brands (brand1.example, brand2.example). Is wildcard proofing supported?

ryan.eng: Short: GA product requires exact domain proof per tenant. Wildcard or delegated verification is not GA. We can propose an engineering engagement (Private/Dedicated extension) to add delegated proofing — ballpark 3-5 weeks dev + testing. Documented as optional SOW item.

leah.s: Need to confirm JIT provisioning vs SCIM-only. If they want JIT, we'll need ACS/Assertion config and a test flow. Will include both flows in the runbook.

kevin.s: Can someone paste a SCIM PATCH example for the customer's SRE to test delta replays?

ryan.eng: Sample SCIM PATCH for email update:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/9b8f"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails[primary eq true].value","value":"john.doe@brand1.example"}]}'
```

leah.s: I'll assemble the runbook: SAML metadata exchange steps, SCIM delta replay script, group flatten guidance, delegated admin test plan, and RBAC verification checklist. Will add troubleshooting hints for assertion size and SCIM throttles.

ops-bot: ops-bot: EU region deployment note: ensure KMS key policy for eu-key-aurum is added to request.

kevin.s: Team — plan: Tara to send provisional pricing + draft quote, Ryan to produce runbook snippets, Leah to combine QA/security answers, and I'll schedule a technical call with AurumBank for Tue 09:30 CET. Adding dave.sec and olga-ops to the invite.

tara.p: Sending draft quote link now (internal): https://redwood.s3/prequotes/aurumbank-hosted-v1.pdf

leah.s: Will upload runbook to shared drive and drop link here once ready.

kevin.s: Thanks all. keeping momentum. :thumbsup:
